governing_plan: .claude/SPRINT_PLAN.md section 1 (historical findings and hit rule), section 6; ajas.md 'Historical rediscovery'
status: FROZEN before any learned-search run on these studies; canonical_hash (dbench.prospective_campaign.canonical_hash) recorded in runs/development/sprint_v06/historical_protocol_v02_sha256.txt with the raw-byte sha256; the v01 baseline ranked lists are re-scored under v02 without re-running the methods; any change is a new protocol id
purpose: untouched retrospective test: given only the data and the broad target available to a researcher before publication, does a method rank the published spatial relation in its top 20 hypotheses? A paper result, never a tuning loop: a failure is reported, not repaired by changing the model for this task
literature_rule: the publications below were read only to transcribe the finding, the gene sets and the publication dates; nothing from them is given to any method beyond the target definition in given_to_morpheus

episode.loader: morpheus.tier2.substrates.hest_multi.study_episode (Agent D) on the study's sprint_partitions_v01 entry
episode.split: patients of the study sorted by key, shuffled with numpy default_rng(20261015), first ceil(n/2) = support (proposal) patients, the rest = query (held-out) patients
episode.gene_matrix_for_scores: target and proxy scores use the study's full common gene panel (StudyRaw.logcpm aligned to episode rows by sample id and barcode) when the loader provides it, else the episode's genes view; the number of proxy genes present is reported per proxy and per study
episode.neighbours: episode.neighbours[6] and [18] (within-sample KD-tree; never across samples or patients)

score_definition: programme score = mean over the set's genes present in the panel of within-patient-centred log1p-CPM (CPM at 1e4); target scores are then within-patient standardised on the task rows; nbr6 / nbr18 = mean over the 6 / 18 within-sample neighbours (a spot without neighbours keeps its own value); contrast = own - nbr6

given_to_morpheus_defaults.variable_pool_note: genes = the episode's 768 highly variable genes chosen on support rows; programmes = 41 Gavish meta-programmes + 50 Hallmark scores on the full panel; the H-Optimus-0 view is not in the pool for these tasks (every published finding here is transcript-defined); the pool is identical for every method
given_to_morpheus_defaults.transform_note: every pool column is offered under all four transforms as precomputed design columns named '<transform>:<view>:<column>' (own columns unprefixed); a method may also build its own neighbour means through the MethodInput / propose neighbours
excluded: the target set's genes under every transform
own-transform pool columns with within-patient |r| >= 0.9 with the target on support rows (leak guard; listed in every output)
given_to_morpheus_defaults.comparison_model: log1p depth (+ platform one-hot when it varies), within-patient centred; nuisance only

scoring.budget_note: every method returns up to 128 ranked variable sets from support rows only; the top 20 are scored; random_search_matched evaluates as many sets as the learned search reports having evaluated for the same task (at least 128)
scoring.hit_rule: a top-20 hypothesis is a hit if it contains a variable that, under one of the task's stated transforms, (a) is among the 10 design columns under that transform with the largest within-patient |r| with the answer proxy score (a variable outside the design qualifies when its |r| is at least the 10th largest), (b) has |r| >= 0.5, and (c) has the stated sign: sign(r_proxy) x sign(r_target) equals the stated direction; r computed on all task rows (support and query)
scoring.rank_statistic: rank (1-based) of the first hit among the top 20 (infinity if none), with the hit's |r| with the proxy, the task ceiling (largest |r| any design column reaches with any answer proxy under a stated transform) and the number of candidate sets the method evaluated
scoring.heldout_evaluation: the first hit is frozen and evaluated on the query patients with general_discovery.evaluate_frozen_candidate, relation v07_ho (v06 if v07_ho is unavailable), comparison = the nuisance model above, 200 patient-bootstrap draws: general gain with CI and G_HO with CI (k >= 2)
scoring.failure_rule: a miss is reported with the method's top-20 list; no architecture, budget or pool change is made for a task after its first run
scoring.secondary_metric: for every method, hit or not: the largest proxy |r| with the stated sign among its top-20 variables under a stated transform, divided by the task ceiling

publication.citation: Ji AL, Rubin AJ, Thrane K, et al. Multimodal Analysis of Composition and Spatial Architecture in Human Squamous Cell Carcinoma. Cell 182(2):497-514.e22 (2020)
publication.before_date_rule: earliest public date of the finding (journal online date; no preprint found in Europe PMC)

finding_text: cSCC exhibited four tumor subpopulations, three recapitulating normal epidermal states, and a tumor-specific keratinocyte (TSK) population unique to cancer, which localized to a fibrovascular niche. (Summary)

In tumors with clear leading edges, the TSK-adjacent stroma (C4 in patient 2, C2 in patient 10), was enriched for cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF) and endothelial transcripts, highlighting a fibrovascular niche ( Figures 3 D and S3 I). (Results)

Analysis of stroma at a distance of one spot (∼100 μm) away from the TSK-high leading edge demonstrated an enrichment of endothelial and CAF-associated transcripts, further supporting a fibrovascular niche surrounding TSK cells ( Figure S3 M). (Results)

relation.spatial_relation: own-spot TSK score rises with the neighbourhood mean (6 or 18 neighbours) of the fibroblast or endothelial score

given_to_morpheus.target_definition: own-spot TSK score: mean within-patient-centred log1p-CPM of the 10 top TSK signature genes (Ji 2020 Table S3, ranks 1-10), within-patient standardised, all spots

finding_text: Irrespective of the CMS phenotype, SPP1+ macrophages and myofibroblasts were enriched in stromal fibrotic regions, echoing recent findings showing that proportions of these populations influence prognosis beyond CMS classification [7]. (Results)

CMS1-dominated regions displayed a solid growth pattern and immune-rich profile, whereas CMS2-dominated regions were associated with a tubular growth pattern and were immune-deprived (Fig. 3g–j , Supplementary Fig. S4d ), in accordance with previous studies on these molecular subtypes [27]. (Results; secondary)

finding_text: Club-like cells display a senescence-associated secretory phenotype and their presence is linked to increased polymorphonuclear myeloid-derived suppressor cell (PMN-MDSC) activity. (Abstract)

The fraction of Club region spots in a sample correlated positively with its PMN-MDSC activity score calculated from non-Club region spots in both cohorts (Fig. 4b ). Tumor region spots had a higher PMN-MDSC activity score when proximal to Club region spots (Fig. 4c ). (Results)
All non-club spots within 3 rings (300 μm) of two or more adjacent Club region spots were then annotated as ‘proximal’, and all spots further than 3 rings away as ‘distant’. (Methods)

finding_text: We report six conserved meta-programs that distinguish tumor cell function, and find an epithelial-mesenchymal transition meta-program highly enriched at the tumor-normal interface that co-localizes with IL1B-expressing macrophages, offering a potential therapeutic target. (Summary)

Taken together, our findings indicate that IL1B -expressing macrophages (TR Mac.2) are co-localized with EMT high RCC cells macroscopically and microscopically both at the tumor-normal interface and in the tumor core ( Figures S7 C and S7D). (Results)
To take into account cell-types proximally co-localised, the 6 adjacent spots were identified for each spot in the slide. (Methods)

supersedes.v01_result: runs/development/historical_rediscovery_v01/RESULTS.md (0 hits in 16 baseline runs; stays on record with its hit-rule ceiling section)

rationale: Under v01 a hit required a top-20 variable with within-patient |r| >= 0.9 against a hand-written 4-7 gene proxy score. After the v01 baseline runs, Agent F measured the hit-rule ceiling, the largest |r| any design column reaches with the answer proxy: 0.63 for S0 (TLS, nbr18), 0.914 for H1 (fibroblast, nbr18; through the EMT-I programme only), 0.900 for H2 (myofibroblast, nbr6; through TAGLN only) and 0.89 for H3 (Club, nbr18); the proxies' own member genes reach only 0.74-0.83. A hit was therefore impossible on S0 and H3 and possible through a single column on H1 and H2, so v01 measured whether a method happened to name a near-copy of the proxy, not whether it found the published partner. v02 asks the question that generalises to the field: does the method's top 20 contain one of the design's best representatives of the published partner (top 10 by |r| with the proxy under the stated transform, |r| >= 0.5, stated sign). Tasks, proxies, targets, transforms, methods, budgets and cutoffs are unchanged.
